zh-CN.title: 应用插件分类与名片预览
items: 菜单新增应用和插件分类，基础信息支持以好友或陌生人视角预览我的名片
修复链接卡片跳转丢失页面内路由的问题，并补充复制成功提示

en.title: Apps, plugins and profile card previews
items: Browse apps and plugins in separate tabs and preview your profile card from a friend or stranger perspective
Link cards preserve hash routes and copying messages or links shows a success notification
